Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, so just call me the claimant.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, in the right lane.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car lurched forward into the intersection.
Q: Did you notice anything before the impact, like the other vehicle braking or swerving?
A: No. I was looking at the light and didn't see it coming. I heard tires squeal for a second, then the impact.
Q: Were you able to drive your car away from the scene?
A: No, the rear bumper was crushed and the car wouldn't roll properly, so a tow truck took it.
Q: Did you get medical attention?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. My left knee hit the dashboard and it's swollen and painful
when I bend it. They took X-rays and referred me to an orthopedic doctor.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?
A: Yes. Stairs are hard, and I've been using a brace for most of the day. I've missed several days of work because of
it.
Q: Did you have any pain or problems with that knee before the collision?
A: No, not that I can recall. I played recreational soccer on weekends and had no trouble.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'd like to get my car repaired and my medical bills taken care of as soon as possible.
</page>
